meta.name: add-gcal-tool
meta.description: Add Google Calendar as an MCP tool (list calendars, list/search/create events, free/busy queries) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. Multi-calendar and multi-account supported. Mirrors /add-gmail-tool's stub pattern — no raw credentials ever reach the container; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把谷歌日历变成可调用的工具，自动管理日程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在工作流中直接操作谷歌日历
copy.tagline_en: Turn Google Calendar into a callable tool to manage schedules automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Google Calendar directly in your workflow

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会多出访问 Google 日历的工具,能列出日历、查看/搜索/创建事件、查询忙闲状态;支持多个日历和账号,密钥由 OneCLI 注入,容器内不接触原始凭据。
howto.when: 当用户要求“添加 Google 日历”、接入日历账户或让 Claude 能查/建日历时,本技能触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Google 日历添加成 MCP 工具,用 OneCLI 授权。
say.note: 会先检查 OneCLI 连接和 stub 凭据。

say.text: 接入我的 Google 日历,支持多个账号。
让 Agent 能查和创建日历事件,并验证挂载。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can access Google Calendar via MCP: list calendars, view/search/create events, check free/busy. Multi-calendar and multi-account supported; OneCLI injects tokens, raw credentials never reach the container.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add Google Calendar to the agent, connect a calendar account, or let Claude view/create calendar events.

say_en.text: Add Google Calendar as an MCP tool.
say_en.note: Runs pre-flight checks, edits Dockerfile, and registers the MCP server.

say_en.text: Set up Google Calendar for my agent using OneCLI-managed OAuth.
Connect Google Calendar and verify the tool is working.
